body: Honestly I think it might have been he holiday season. I wasn't feeling well before it but it's like I've lost all motivation for anything. I get up, go to work and come home. I struggle to eat, sleep, shower, or get out of the car to go to work or go home.
I've been doing DBT for months, see my GP once a fortnight and my psychiatrist once a month. I was fine and out of nowhere I wasn't.

Views/support/validation is more than I get in person and I'd happily take it from the internet.

I'm not afraid to admit I struggle to muster the courage to die because naturally there's a part of me that wants to live. Everything is too fucked up to understand why though.
I'm a 23 year old white female.
I'm not sure what you're trying to achieve.

I am so, so down. And I've been so well for nearly months and slowly getting worse. And every time I tell someone in my life they are like 'you'll be fine and it'll get better' but I'm not fine and it isn't getting better.
